resource: ItemInstances touched by one DUR-03 native one-item or B3 merge-shape logical transaction
allocation_impact: Checked before allocation or partial mutation; never truncated. MINT, the container-slot TRANSFER and the new-entry TRANSFER touch exactly one ItemInstance (before and after are the same item); the B3 full-merge and top-up shapes touch exactly two (source A and receiver B).
boundary_tests: max=1: MINT and the one-item TRANSFER shapes each touch exactly one ItemInstance
max=2: the full-merge and top-up TRANSFER shapes touch exactly A and B
max+1=3: a usage of three touched ItemInstances is rejected (CAPACITY_EXCEEDED)
max+1 for the one-item shapes: a TRANSFER whose before and after ItemInstance ids differ is rejected
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/item_mint_audit.rs (stage C runtime MINT: TransactionResourceUsage::MINT checked before freeze and in the payload gate)
apps/game-server/src/durability/item_transfer_audit.rs (B3-1 runtime TRANSFER: TransferShape::usage checked in the payload gate and before commit)
apps/game-server/src/durability/house_interior_audit.rs and house_interior.rs (HOUSE-RUNTIME-1a: closed one-item House place/take/tile-move, same-transaction custody/receipt/event)
notes: D50/D51, decision §§3.1-3.3; owner direction #162 comment 5866606575; registered by OTV2-20260928-dur03-b4-binding-513. Amended by B3-INVENTORY-DESTINATION-CAPACITY-STACKS-V1 §4.5 (2 for the merge and top-up shapes, 1 otherwise); registered by OTV2-20260928-b3-1-transfer.
